Text: WHEN a member redeems posted points, the loyalty service shall issue a voucher worth SGD 1 per 100 points redeemed.
Rationale: Redemption rate in the programme terms.
Title: Issue a voucher for redeemed points

Text: WHEN a cashier applies a voucher worth more than the purchase, the loyalty service shall keep the unused voucher value for a later purchase.
Rationale: Cashiers get complaints about lost voucher value (I-02).
Title: Partial redemption of a voucher

Text: WHEN a member opens an issued voucher, the customer mobile app shall display the voucher as a QR code the POS can scan.
Title: Show voucher QR code in the app

Text: WHEN a member cancels an unused voucher, the loyalty service shall return the voucher's points to the member's posted balance.
Rationale: Support handles cancellations by hand today (S-03).
Title: Cancel an unused voucher

Text: WHEN a member transfers posted points to another member, the loyalty service shall move the points between the two balances.
Title: Gift points to another member
